script_text: A cosmic storm is brewing in your chart that Aquarius cannot afford to ignore. Early week, your ruler Uranus in the 1st House squares Mercury in the 4th on Monday, sparking tense family talks, while Tuesday favors career as the Sun in the 7th trines Pluto in the 10th, boosting money through partnerships. Mid-week, the turning point arrives Wednesday when Venus enters your 5th House, igniting passionate new love prospects. Late week, Mars in the 9th sextiles Saturn in the 11th Thursday, grounding travel or group plans, and the weekend flows with easy social vibes as the Moon conjuncts Jupiter in the 3rd. Wednesday is your power day because Venus enters your 5th House with romantic luck. Monday is your worst day because Uranus squares Mercury, fracturing home peace. Schedule key negotiations Tuesday under the Sun-Pluto trine. Follow for daily updates.
